Name: Xiddav's Old Family Farm
Author: xiddav
Description:
New Farm Map.


The red truck is a warp to the other red truck. You have to upgrade your axe to remove the logs to reach the drivers seat.

Fishing - 2 fish can be caught on this farm. Large Mouth Bass and the new Blue Gill.

Grill functions like a kitchen so you can start [b]cooking [/b]day 1

[b]Stumps [/b]renew if set to true in the config.

Upper left is a Quarry. Ores will spawn if you have [b]Spawn Ore[/b] true in the config.

The [b]Walls[/b] and [b]Floors [/b]of upgraded house is different then normal.

Can change the [b]starting gift[/b] before making a new game.

Downloads.Description: A new fish that can only be caught on this farm, and they seem to like Dandelions.
